description: Subtracts one voltage from another, in two independent sections, with no clipping

inputs.text: The voltage that the other input of its section is subtracted from
The voltage subtracted from the upper input of its section

outputs.text: The upper input of its section minus the lower one; nothing limits the result, so it can run well beyond -5V to 5V

notes: the two sections are separate; neither input of one reaches the other
